name: Incursio
description: (Tag:bound)(Tag:draconic)(Tag:enhancer)(Tag:growing)(Tag:polearm)(Tag:stealth)(Tag:weapon)Dubbed "Demon Armor", Incursio is a shortsword "Key" Teigu that forms incredibly durable armor massively enhancing physical abilities, with camouflage invisibility and semi-living adaptation that evolves with user compatibility at massive stamina cost. A highly compatible user can further evolve and fuse with it into its original beast's full dragon form. As this item is a Teigu, it is difficult to master, can only be used by compatible people, and may kill an incompatible activator outright.
